arm: W-F v3 - canonical GEPA on a fair inner split

partition.what: W-F v3 partition: TEST is held out entirely; TRAIN splits into REFLECT (minibatches + reflection traces) and VALID (acceptance, Pareto rewards, winner choice). Consultation-level throughout.

objective.primary: paired tie-adjusted discrimination on omissions, on VALID
objective.secondary: absolute detection at the best threshold with FA <= 10% on VALID's clean twins
objective.acceptance: PROMISCUOUS - a child enters the pool on a minibatch improvement in mean per-instance reward; the per-instance Pareto frontier prunes afterwards
objective.selection: per-instance Pareto frontier on VALID, parents sampled in proportion to instances led
objective.merge: reflector-mediated crossover of two frontier candidates leading on disjoint instances (see module docstring: the paper's module-swap is undefined for a one-module system)

pipeline.what: the B2 pipeline judge's CHECK module (extraction frozen and cached)

artifact.why: the winner does not beat the B2 baseline on the primary measure on held-out TEST (-0.0229 paired), so no v3 prompt file is written - only v3_results.json records what the search found

mono.what: the grid's FC-score monolithic judge at k=1

gate.why: v3m-08 beats seed_fc_score on VALID by +7.3pp paired and +22.9pp det@FA<=10%; the gate needs >2pp on both
